summary: StoryFy Admin Portal Phase 2 - All features tested and working. Backend APIs (14 tests) passed 100%. Frontend UI flows for unified login with Creator/Admin toggle, Admin Stories browser, Story Detail, and read-only Project Viewer all tested successfully.

TestAdminStoriesList.test_get_stories_with_admin_token: PASSED - Returns 8 stories with creator info

TestAdminStoryDetail.test_get_story_detail_with_admin_token: PASSED - Returns story, creator info, and episodes

TestAdminEpisodeProject.test_get_episode_project_with_admin_toke: PASSED - Returns episode, story, creator, and project_state

TestUnifiedLoginEndpoints.test_creator_rejected_from_admin_login: PASSED - Creator gets 403 on admin login

unified_login_page.details: Login page shows Creator/Admin toggle. Default is Creator mode with cyan accent.

creator_mode_elements.details: Creator mode shows email/password fields, Google login button, Sign Up link, cyan Submit button

admin_mode_elements.details: Admin mode shows only email/password, purple accent, 'Access Admin Panel' button. Google login and Sign Up hidden.

admin_login_redirect.details: Admin login with admin@admin.com/admin123 redirects to /admin-access/dashboard

creator_login_redirect.details: Creator login with testapi@test.com/password123 redirects to /dashboard (not admin routes)

admin_stories_page.details: Shows 8 stories with title, genre, creator name, creator email, episodes count. Navigation bar has Dashboard, Creators, Stories links.

stories_search_filter.details: Searching 'testapi' filters to 1 story. Searching 'fiction' shows all 8 fiction stories.

story_detail_page.details: Shows story info (title, genre, language), creator name/email, episodes list with status, track/clip counts. Back to Stories button works.

project_viewer.details: Read-only timeline displays 3 tracks (Voice=cyan, Background Music=gold, Sound Effects=orange), clips with names/durations, zoom controls working (1.00x default), Read-Only badge displayed.

admin_nav_bar.details: Dashboard, Creators, Stories links present on all admin pages. Stories highlighted in cyan when active.

critical_code_review_comments: Phase 2 implementation follows correct patterns from Phase 1
Admin-only endpoints properly protected with require_admin dependency
Project viewer is read-only as expected - no edit functionality
Track colors match expected design: voice=cyan, music=gold, sfx=orange
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (8 stories, episodes with project_state)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Portal Phase 2 complete. New APIs: GET /api/admin-9821/stories (list all stories with creator info), GET /api/admin-9821/stories/:id/episodes (story detail), GET /api/admin-9821/episodes/:id/project (project state viewer). New frontend routes: /admin-access/stories, /admin-access/stories/:storyId, /admin-access/projects/:episodeId. Unified login at /login with Creator/Admin toggle replaces separate admin login page.
